decision: Prioritize exact-page query evidence for Presoterapia, then Compresión; preserve redirect routes and metadata until a demonstrated cause exists. Reconcile incoming official Google examples by exact URL.
remaining_conditions: Additional official examples and verified exact-page query exports
Dated served snippet and landing evidence before metadata mismatch claims
Destination/chain and thematic evidence before any redirect proposal
Explicit viable bounded scope before future redirect HTTP authorization
restrictions: No network to Rhino or Google
No menus, content, catalog, metadata or canonical edits
not_authorized: No new execution or publication request is issued by this ADR.
